fact: 1934年10月，第五次围剿失败后，中共决定放弃江西瑞金中央苏区；10月16日博古与奥托·布劳恩率约13万军民从于都突破国民党封锁线，实际完成突围的有8.6万军队、1.1万行政人员及数千民夫。长征持续至1935年10月约10000公里。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Long March
sources.quote: on 10 October 1934 the CCP decided to abandon its Jiangxi Soviet and headquarters in Ruijin, Jiangxi. The First Front Red Army of some 86,000 troops headed west... On October 16, 1934, a force of about 130,000 soldiers and civilians under Bo Gu and Otto Braun attacked the line of Kuomintang positions near Yudu. More than 86,000 troops, 11,000 administrative personnel and thousands of civilian porters actually completed the breakout.

fact: 1934年11月30日至12月25日，红一方面军在湘江与国民党军激战，渡过湘江时仅剩约3.6万人；从出发时8.6万人锐减过半。1934年11月瑞金陷落，留下的瞿秋白与毛泽东之弟毛泽覃等被俘后被处决。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Long March
sources.quote: by the time it crossed the Xiang River on 1 December had only 36,000 men left... Several prominent members of the Chinese Soviet who remained behind were captured and executed by the Kuomintang after the fall of Ruijin in November 1934, including Qu Qiubai and the youngest brother of Mao Zedong, Mao Zetan.

fact: 1933年中国宣布元为标准货币单位，1元等于26.6971克880成色银；当年西方多已因大萧条放弃金本位，中国因坚持银本位几乎避开萧条。但1934年美国《白银收购法》制造对中国银币的不可承受需求，导致白银外流与通货紧缩。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Silver standard
sources.quote: the yuan was again announced as the standard unit in 1933, but this time the relationship of the yuan to the tael was abolished, as one yuan was now equal to 26.6971 grams of 880 fineness silver... the US silver purchase act of 1934 created an intolerable demand on China silver coins.

fact: 1934年10月，国民政府提高基于白银的出口税并加征所谓平衡税，使关税基于外币计征；这些措施是对美国1933年伦敦经济会议后白银收购计划造成中国通缩的回应，最终导致1935年9月放弃银本位、发行法币。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Silver standard
sources.quote: In October 1934, the National Government of Republic of China increased the silver-based export duty and adjusted the duty with a so-called equalisation charge, making the duty based on foreign currencies. The Government later issued a new currency called fa-pi. These changes were responses to the deflation in China caused by the US Silver Purchase Program in 1933.

fact: 长征前中共中央指定博古（政治）、布劳恩（军事）、周恩来（后勤执行）组织撤退；撤退计划完全保密，连高级领导人也是最后一刻才被告知谁走谁留。约1.6万部队与项英、陈毅、瞿秋白等留下组建后卫牵制国军。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Long March
sources.quote: the Standing Committee appointed Bo (responsible for politics), Braun (responsible for military strategy), and Zhou (responsible for the implementation of military planning) to organize the evacuation. Since the enemy was close, Zhou, in charge of logistics, made his plans in complete secrecy... 16,000 troops and some of the Communists most notable commanders... were left to form a rear guard.

fact: 长征出发时红军约8.6万军队加1.1万行政人员及数千民夫；湘江战役后仅剩3.6万人，到1935年10月到达陕北时仅约8000人生还。沿途需要民夫搬运辎重、粮食与伤员，后勤完全依赖就地征用与缴获。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Long March
sources.quote: About 100,000 troops retreated from the Jiangxi Soviet and other bases to a new headquarters in Yanan, Shaanxi... About 8,000 troops ultimately survived the Long March... More than 86,000 troops, 11,000 administrative personnel and thousands of civilian porters actually completed the breakout.

fact: 上海作为中国银本位金融中心，1934年白银外流导致银根紧缩、利率上升、通缩；国民政府10月加征白银出口税后，白银走私出口成为灰色生意，外滩银行与钱庄面临储备流失。法币改革前夜，外汇与白银套利空间扩大。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Silver standard
sources.quote: The US purchase of silver in the International market increase the price of silver, causing an outflow of silver in China who based the economy on silver standard currency, which forces China to abandon the silver standard.

fact: 长征途中红军翻越崎岖地形（含藏区东部），以重大代价突破蒋介石数道封锁线；伤兵病员多被留下分散到农村，瑞金陷落后留下的瞿秋白、毛泽覃等被俘处决。湘江一战从8.6万减至3.6万，非战斗减员（饥饿、疾病、逃亡）未在来源中单列。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Long March
sources.quote: The Red Army broke several of Chiang blockades with heavy losses... the remainder, largely wounded or ill soldiers, continued to fight a delaying action after the main force had left, and then dispersed into the countryside.

fact: 1934年中国货币体系仍为银本位，1933年废两改元后1元等于26.6971克880成色银；上海外滩银行与钱庄以白银库存为储备基础，美国白银收购推高国际银价后，上海白银通过口岸流出，银根紧缩传导至全国。
